cleanup.description: Remove left vehicles: Off: vehicles players leave stay until the server restarts.

cleanupScope.description: Which vehicles: Owned vehicles are the ones players bought or that belong to a job or gang.

abandonMinutes.description: Removed after: Minutes after the driver got out, for a vehicle left anywhere but a garage spot.

garageMinutes.description: Removed after: Minutes after the driver got out, for a vehicle left on a garage spot.

scanSeconds.description: Check every: How often the server looks at who drives what. Shorter notices quick rides; longer costs less on big servers.

ownedTo.description: Owned vehicles go to: Garage: the garage of the spot the vehicle was left on; a vehicle left elsewhere, or one the garage refuses, goes to the impound.

garage.description: Garage id: The garage script's id of this garage (ai-garages: the garage's key). Empty: the spot only shortens the time.

notifyGarage.description: Tell the driver: The driver who leaves a vehicle on a garage spot is told when it will be towed.

blacklist.description: Never removed: Vehicle models the removal skips.

keepDriven.description: Keep driven vehicles: A street vehicle a player drives stays in the world when no player is near, until it is removed as a left vehicle.
